kita.title: TCS in day-care centres
kita.subtitle: Safe space for little explorers
kita.text: In day-care centres, the protection of children has top priority, while at the same time educational daily life must run smoothly. Our video door intercom systems enable effective visual control at the entrance. Through networked indoor stations and the forwarding of door calls to mobile DECT phones or smartphones, educators are reachable at all times. Digital info boards inform parents about current dates in a contemporary way.

schulen.title: TCS in schools
schulen.subtitle: Networked security in everyday school life
schulen.text: Schools require the highest level of overview and rapid response options. TCS offers simplified access control for teachers and caretakers as well as direct room-to-room communication. Special attention is paid to our emergency call systems, which enable a targeted call to internal and external rescue forces in dangerous situations.

wohnheime.title: TCS in residence halls
wohnheime.subtitle: As flexible as their residents
wohnheime.text: Student and staff residence halls are characterised by frequent tenant changes. TCS drastically minimises administrative effort: through digital name plates at the outdoor stations that are updated via a web interface, manual replacement is eliminated. Intelligent access controls via transponder or numerical code replace large bunches of keys.

pflege.title: TCS in care and assisted living
pflege.subtitle: Barrier-free support in everyday life
pflege.text: Our solutions are consistently designed barrier-free according to DIN 18040-1 and offer visual as well as acoustic support. Residents can reach the staff directly via large buttons or mobile call buttons on the wristband. Forwarding to mobile devices ensures that caregivers are reachable at any time and travel times are minimised.

medizin.title: TCS in medical facilities
medizin.subtitle: Well communicated, better oriented
medizin.text: In practices, medical centres and clinics, patient flows must be directed efficiently. Digital info boards inform about room occupancy and opening hours, while clear signage makes orientation easier. Automatic door openers and access controls for sensitive areas bring noticeable relief.

behoerden.title: TCS in authorities and offices
behoerden.subtitle: Work efficiently, guide securely
behoerden.text: Public administrations require regulated access and smooth visitor management. With TCS, you integrate access controls that can be administered quickly and flexibly thanks to cloud connection. In addition to office doors, barrier systems and parking machines can also be seamlessly integrated.

feuerwehren.title: TCS in fire services
feuerwehren.subtitle: More efficient and faster in operation
feuerwehren.text: When every second counts, the building technology must work perfectly. TCS equips rescue stations with robust systems where all functions of the site can be triggered and monitored from a communication centre. Keyless personnel access ensures that emergency personnel reach their vehicles without delay.

baeder.title: TCS in swimming pools and lidos
baeder.subtitle: Visitor-friendly and safely stored
baeder.text: In addition to clear guidance for bathers, the focus is on securing functional areas. With TCS transponder solutions or code locks, staff areas and lockers in changing rooms can be secured easily and effectively. External driveways such as barrier systems can be integrated into the overall system.

pulse-berlin.title: PULSE, Berlin
pulse-berlin.description: Modern commercial new build with more than 200 residential units and fully digital TCS door communication including video and app integration.
longDescription: PULSE in Berlin-Friedrichshain is one of the most ambitious new building projects in the capital. Across several floors it combines residential, commercial and shared spaces into a vibrant urban quarter.

TCS was selected as the system partner for the entire door communication and access control. More than 200 residential units were equipped with state-of-the-art video intercom systems that enable seamless communication between residents and visitors.

A particular highlight is the full app integration: residents can answer door calls directly on their smartphone and open the door from anywhere. The system was integrated into the existing smart home infrastructure.

weidt-park-corner.title: Weidt Park Corner, Berlin Mitte
weidt-park-corner.description: Exclusive residential complex with integrated access control and modern video intercom for the highest level of comfort.
longDescription: Weidt Park Corner in Berlin-Mitte defines urban living at the highest level. The exclusive residential complex combines architectural elegance with state-of-the-art building technology.

For this project, TCS developed a tailor-made solution made up of video intercom and access control. Each of the 85 residential units is equipped with a high-resolution video indoor station with touchscreen operation.
The access control system enables convenient and secure access management – from the underground car park to the apartment door. Residents use RFID transponders or the TCS app for keyless access.

fritztower.title: Fritztower, Berlin
fritztower.description: High-rise project with 35 floors – TCS systems for door communication and building management on every level.
longDescription: With 35 floors, the Fritztower is one of the tallest residential buildings in Berlin. The striking high-rise at Tiergarten sets standards for modern urban living.
The particular challenge was to implement a uniform communication and access system across all 35 floors and 375 apartments. To this end, TCS designed a scalable BUS solution.
The TCS building management system networks all access points centrally and enables efficient administration. The concierge function in the entrance area complements the technical infrastructure.

haupttelegraphenamt.title: Haupttelegraphenamt, Berlin
haupttelegraphenamt.description: Heritage-compliant refurbishment with integration of modern TCS intercom systems into historic façades and entrance areas.
longDescription: The historic Haupttelegraphenamt in Berlin-Mitte is an architectural gem from the founding era. The heritage-compliant refurbishment placed the highest demands on the integration of modern technology.

For this project, TCS developed special solutions that blend harmoniously into the historic façades and entrance areas. The outdoor stations were individually adapted to the appearance of the building.
Despite heritage protection requirements, a fully fledged video door communication system could be installed, offering residents state-of-the-art comfort.
highlights: Modern technology in a heritage building

spichern-2.title: Spichern 2, Berlin
spichern-2.description: Mixed use with separate access zones for commercial and residential tenants – realised with TCS system technology.
longDescription: Spichern 2 is a modern mixed-use building in Berlin-Wilmersdorf that brings different types of use together under one roof.

The particular challenge was the strict separation of access zones: commercial tenants and residents need separate entrances with individual permission profiles. TCS implemented a multi-stage access system.
The intercom was configured so that commercial and residential areas can be reached via separate call lists. Central administration allows flexible adjustment of permissions.

thulestrasse.title: Thulestraße, Berlin
thulestrasse.description: Multi-family house with 48 parties, equipped with audio and video indoor stations and mobile door release.
longDescription: The multi-family house on Thulestraße in popular Prenzlauer Berg combines contemporary living with comfortable building technology.
All 48 residential units were equipped with a combination of audio and video indoor stations. Residents can choose between a classic intercom and video transmission.

The mobile door opening function is particularly appreciated: via the TCS app, residents can also see who is ringing while on the move and open the door if needed – ideal for parcel deliveries and visitors.

quartier-heidestrasse.title: Quartier Heidestrasse, Berlin
quartier-heidestrasse.description: Large-scale urban quarter with several buildings – central TCS access management and concierge solution.
longDescription: Quartier Heidestrasse is one of the largest urban development projects in Berlin. On the former goods station site, a new urban quarter is emerging with living, working and leisure.
TCS supplied the communication and access solution for the entire quarter with more than 500 units. Central access management allows cross-building control of all access points.
A particular requirement was the concierge solution: via a central reception, visitors can be directed to all buildings in the quarter. The system is designed to be scalable for future extensions.

luisenpark-residenz.title: Luisenpark Residenz, München
luisenpark-residenz.description: Upmarket residential complex with biometric access control and individual intercom for each unit.
longDescription: The Luisenpark Residenz in Munich-Schwabing sets new standards for upmarket living. The exclusive complex combines classic architecture with forward-looking building technology.
For this premium property, TCS implemented biometric access control. Residents can access the underground car park, main entrance and apartment via fingerprint, RFID or app.
Each of the 45 residential units has an individually configured intercom system with personalised name display and high-resolution video transmission.

klinikum-sued.title: Klinikum Süd, Stuttgart
klinikum-sued.description: New hospital build with TCS door communication for wards, emergency room and administrative areas.
longDescription: Klinikum Süd in Stuttgart is a modern new hospital build with the highest demands on safety, hygiene and communication.

TCS implemented a comprehensive door communication and access system for all 12 wards, the emergency room and all administrative areas. Special hygiene requirements were met by contactless access solutions.
The system is integrated into the hospital IT and enables central management of all access points. In an emergency, areas can be locked or released immediately.

rathaus-neustadt.title: Rathaus Neustadt, Dresden
rathaus-neustadt.description: Modernisation of the town hall with barrier-free TCS intercoms and a digital name directory.
longDescription: Rathaus Neustadt in Dresden was equipped with contemporary communication technology as part of a comprehensive modernisation.
The focus was on barrier-free design: all intercoms are mounted to be wheelchair-accessible and feature large, high-contrast displays as well as inductive hearing support.
The digital name directory at the main entrance enables citizens to navigate intuitively and contact the desired departments and case workers directly.

campus-westend.title: Campus Westend, Frankfurt
campus-westend.description: University campus with more than 30 building entrances – central access control and intercom via TCS.
longDescription: The Westend campus of Goethe University Frankfurt is one of the most modern university campuses in Germany. The extensive complex comprises more than 30 buildings with different usage requirements.
TCS implemented a central access control solution that networks all building entrances. Students, employees and visitors are granted individual access permissions via chip cards.
The intercoms at the main entrances enable secure communication with the reception and campus security. The system is integrated into the existing university IT.

seniorenresidenz-am-park.title: Seniorenresidenz Am Park, Hamburg
seniorenresidenz-am-park.description: Barrier-free intercom with large displays, hearing support and connection to the care system.
longDescription: Seniorenresidenz Am Park in Hamburg-Blankenese offers 80 residents a comfortable and safe home. Accessibility and ease of use were the key planning priorities.
TCS installed an intercom system tailored to the needs of older people. Large 7-inch displays, particularly loud speakers and inductive hearing support ensure the best possible communication.

The system is connected to the nursing call system: in an emergency, residents can reach the nursing staff directly via the intercom. The central administration allows easy adjustment when residents change.
